title: Tier Pollen gets a daily balance
summary:
Tier Pollen moved to daily balances, while Enter and the README caught up on yesterday's model and SDK news.

Tier and Pollen balances moved to D1. New accounts start on Spore with 1 Pollen; tier balances reset at 00:00 UTC without rollover, including 500 Pollen for Router. Requests draw from the tier balance first, then crypto, then packs. Enter also gained a clearer tier-balance breakdown. Pack checkout currently returns 503, while the customer portal remains available.

Enter's news highlights now cover Wan 2.6 image-to-video with audio, Klein Large image generation and editing, the Pollinations provider for Vercel AI SDK, and Gemini 2.5 Pro. This was a news update, not a model or SDK change.

The README's ten-item Latest News list now includes those January 26 highlights, rotating out older entries.
